meta.title: Wetherspoons Cardiff: pub locations and menu guide
meta.description: Find Wetherspoons Cardiff pubs by area, understand typical pricing and check breakfast and club days. Choose your pub with practical visiting advice.

intro: This guide covers {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Cardiff across {areaCount} areas, with choices in City Centre, Windsor Place, Central Station and Cardiff Bay. Every pub works from the national [Wetherspoons menu](/), but prices are set locally. This guide explains where each pub is, how menu pricing works and what to check before ordering. Use it to choose a location, plan breakfast or check club days. SpoonsMenu is an independent guide and is not affiliated with J D Wetherspoon plc.
quickAnswer: There are {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs listed in Cardiff: The Prince of Wales in City Centre, The Central Bar in Windsor Place, The Great Western in Central Station and The Mount Stuart in Cardiff Bay. Their menus are broadly similar, but each pub sets its own prices, so check your chosen location before ordering.

areas.text: The Prince of Wales is the listed Wetherspoons option in City Centre, on St Mary Street. It suits visitors choosing this area for their meal. Check its current menu rather than assuming the prices match another Cardiff pub, particularly if you are comparing a specific order.

The Central Bar is the listed pub in Windsor Place, with its address on Windsor Place itself. Choose it if this is the area where you want to eat. For a particular breakfast or main course, check the pub's current menu and typical price before deciding.

The Great Western is the listed Wetherspoons pub for the Central Station area, on St Mary Street. It suits anyone looking for an option in this part of Cardiff. Compare its current menu prices with your other choices rather than assuming station-area pricing will be the same.

The Mount Stuart is the listed Wetherspoons option in Cardiff Bay, with an address at Stuart Terrace, Mermaid Quay. It suits visitors who want to eat in this area. Check the selected pub's menu for your preferred dish and its typical price before placing an order.

pricing:
Wetherspoons menu prices in Cardiff vary by pub, even though the menu is broadly the same nationally. Popular national choices include [burgers](/burgers), curries, fish and chips and pizza, but a shared menu does not mean a shared price.

City centre and station pubs often charge more than suburban pubs. That is a general pattern, not proof that any particular Cardiff pub is cheaper or more expensive than another. All prices should be treated as typical and checked at the location you choose.

To confirm the exact price for your order, select the correct pub in the Wetherspoon app or check its current menu at the bar. Compare the same dish across pubs for a useful comparison.
breakfastAndClubs:
Breakfast at Wetherspoons is typically served from eight in the morning until noon, while [Steak Club](/steak-club) is traditionally on Tuesday and [Curry Club](/curry-club) on Thursday at participating pubs. These are general timings and club days, so confirm the details with your chosen Cardiff pub before planning around them.

The traditional breakfast is among the popular dishes on the national menu. If that is your preferred order, check the selected pub's current menu. For club visits, ask about participation, the current dishes and typical prices rather than assuming every location offers the same arrangement.
